facts.fact: Border charter: if the Keeper's seal is found false, the warden may close the pass with his own seal alone, but the writ needs a witness of the warden's house marked beside the seal. Devan cites the single-seal line to Ittan in the courtyard before the search. Gopan names the witness requirement at the gate-tower.
Neela writes her name, with 'of Kettamala', as the household witness on the closing writ. The writ goes to Kodiyur, so her name is on a crown record.

Devan stood the five carts under the padippura roof overnight with Bhaskaran's men round them as a courtesy; Ittan's clerk came down at the middle watch with a lantern and was turned back, so the chest was never moved.
Ittan carried the 36 blank waxed tokens to wax passes under the widow's seal, where no clerk counts a seal box.

Devan reads Chathu's slip aloud, says only that his wife brought it before the new moon and that it came off a courier's papers, and names no source. He knowingly lets Muthu carry 'my wife brought me this'.
Neela's bound hand gripping the stair rail pulls at Devan's right wrist, within the wound-share limits of F265.
